findings.RV01: Retained note lines and issuer launch dates corroborate execution.
findings.RV02: FOX separate publication is current only.
findings.RV03: Project boundary and deployed capital do not provide measurable outcomes.
findings.RV04: CWIP is carrying amount and FOX is equity accounted in 2026.
findings.RV05: Missing utilization and earned yield prevent an operating model or band.
findings.RV06: Completion/segment improvement is not allocation return. Group cash deterioration is not repeated project destruction.

findings.RV01: Completion receipts and period-market rows are dated.
findings.RV02: AGM Appendix II and Board terms support KPI and lock-up.
findings.RV03: Cash receipt is gross; attribution of retention and productivity stays unbounded.
findings.RV04: Pro-rata stock issue and employee cohorts are treated separately.
findings.RV05: Valuation scenarios straddle uncertainty in economics; thresholds are not forecast benefits.
findings.RV06: Negative TSR eliminates TSR leg. Transfer alone does not choose a binary band.
